From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Subject: POC Observability Plan & Next Steps - FintechX

Hi Sam / Asha,

Great to meet you both on the call today — thanks for the overview of FintechX's objectives. As promised, here's a concise recap and a proposed observability plan for the 4-week POC so we can align on success criteria, owners, and timelines.

Quick recap from our discovery:
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for customer-facing fraud scoring (low-latency, 99th %ile < 120ms for small requests) and cost per inference below $0.004/token equivalent for the expected volume.
- Primary evaluation signals: latency distribution, per-request cost, correctness regressions on a held-out prompt set, and infra stability under burst traffic.
- POC scope: sandbox integration using your dev cluster + Redwood private deployment; sample dataset & 100k inference budget.

Proposed observability plan (summary) — details in attached template:
1) Dashboards (Grafana):
   - Latency dashboard: p50/p95/p99, request size, model variant breakdown, per-route latency.
   - Cost dashboard: tokens per request, total tokens, estimated token cost by model/route.
   - Success/quality dashboard: pass rate on golden prompt set (automated evals), example drift alerts.
2) Tracing:
   - Distributed traces for request flow (ingest -> routing -> model inference -> postprocess). Sample traces for cold vs warm KV cache.
3) Logs & exports:
   - Stream structured request/response logs (redacted PII) to your ELK / BigQuery. Key fields: request_id, model_version, latency_ms, token_count, route, customer_id (hashed).
4) Metrics to monitor (alerts):
   - p99 latency > 200ms (page), error rate > 1% (page), token cost delta > 20% compared to baseline (warn), drift on evaluation prompts (warn + slack).
5) Ownership & timeline:
   - Redwood owner: Jordan Blake (integration lead) and Marcus Lin (runtime/ops).
   - FintechX owner: Sam Patel (POC lead) and Asha Rao (security/compliance).
   - Week 0 (this week): integration + baseline run; Week 1: dashboards + tracing; Week 2: load tests and quality evals; Week 3: final validation and wrap-up.

Next steps:
- Sam: confirm the dataset location and the sandbox cluster details we can push logs to.
- Asha: confirm any additional redaction requirements for logs or retention limits.
- We'll share the observability template (attached) and a lightweight runbook for dashboard access.

Attachments: observability-poc-template.xlsx (template), redwood-infra-overview.pdf

Happy to jump on a 30-min follow-up if you'd like to walk through the dashboards.

Best,

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

Sam — great questions. Below are the concrete targets and the logging/schema details. I've attached the template workbook with the dashboard panels and the runbook.

POC success criteria (numeric):
- Latency: p95 < 90ms, p99 < 140ms (measured on production-like dev cluster under expected request size distribution).
- Error rate: < 0.5% (server-side errors, request failures).
- Cost: average token-equivalent cost per inference < $0.004 (we'll compute using token counts in logs).
- Quality: >= 92% pass rate on your golden prompt set (we'll run nightly evals and surface failures).

Logging/export schema (CSV/BigQuery fields):
- timestamp (ISO8601), request_id, route, model_version, model_variant, latency_ms, token_count, cost_estimate_usd, response_length, eval_pass (bool/null), error_code (if any), customer_id_hash, region, infra_node_id

Redaction & retention:
- We will redact PII fields at export time. By default we omit any free-text user messages from exports unless you opt-in; hashed customer_id will allow joins but not reversible PII.
- Retention: we can set export retention to 90 days as requested.

Dashboards / sample view:
- Link: https://drive.google.com/fintechx/observability-snapshot (attachment includes a PNG snapshot of the latency and quality panels).

Owners & timeline (confirmed):
- Jordan (Redwood): integration + dashboard setup (Week 0–1)
- Marcus (Redwood): runtime tuning + load test (Week 2)
- Sam (FintechX): provide dataset + BigQuery sink details by Mon 12/1
- Asha (FintechX): confirm redaction/retention by Mon 12/1

Next steps:
- Jordan: schedule 30-min dashboard walkthrough (propose Tue 12/1 10:00am PT) — sending calendar invite.
- Sam / Asha: share S3 path & BigQuery dataset/credentials for export.

Attachments: observability-poc-template.xlsx, draft-sla.docx, redwood-infra-overview.pdf
